title: The Lord Upholds My Life

questions.question: O God, save me by your name, and vindicate me by your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:1 (ESV): "O God, save me by your name, and vindicate me by your might."

questions.question: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:2 (ESV): "O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth."

questions.question: For strangers have risen against me; ruthless men seek my what?
They do not set whom before themselves?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:3 (ESV): "they do not set God before themselves."

questions.question: The Lord is the upholder of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:4 (ESV): "The Lord is the upholder of my life."

questions.question: He will return the evil to my enemies; in your faithfulness put an end to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:5 (ESV): "...in your faithfulness put an end to them."

questions.question: With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, O Lord, for it is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:6 (ESV): "...I will give thanks to your name, O Lord, for it is good."

questions.question: For he has delivered me from every trouble, and my eye has looked in triumph on my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:7 (ESV): "For he has delivered me from every trouble, and my eye has looked in triumph on my enemies."

questions.question: This Psalm was written when the Ziphites told Saul that who was hiding among them?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54 Title: "...when the Ziphites went and told Saul, 'Is not David hiding among us?'"

questions.question: What type of Psalm is Psalm 54 identified as in the title?
Who are the ruthless men seeking?
For strangers have risen against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:3 (ESV): "For strangers have risen against me;"

questions.question: In your faithfulness do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:5 (ESV): "...in your faithfulness put an end to them."

questions.question: I will sacrifice to you with what kind of offering?
questions.explanation: Psalm 54:6 (ESV): "With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you;"

key_verse_text: Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is the upholder of my life.
